description: In this world, there exist vicious monsters called goblins. These terrifying creatures attack people, kidnap women, rape them, impregnate them, and then reproduce. The goblin`s next target was the devout pilgrim, Anvil. "Lord, please protect my life from this monster." Anvil`s prayers were in vain, and she was captured. Trembling in fear, she leans on her faith in God and prepares herself for death. But what awaited her was something even more terrifying than death: hideous goblins swarming the innocent woman.

titles.title: 巡礼者 アンヴィル
